name: Penpot
short_description: Open-source Figma alternative for collaborative UI design and prototyping.
description: Penpot is a free, open-source design and prototyping platform built on open web standards (SVG). Teams collaborate in real-time on vector UI designs, interactive prototypes, and design systems — all in the browser, with no proprietary file formats. It supports components, design tokens, grids, constraints, and exporting assets, making it a complete Figma alternative you fully control. Backed by PostgreSQL for data and Redis for real-time collaboration.
usecases: Design UI mockups and prototypes collaboratively in the browser.
Build and share reusable design systems and component libraries.
Create interactive prototypes with transitions to hand off to developers.
Replace Figma with a fully self-hosted, open-source alternative.
notes: Set PUBLIC_URI to your server's URL so assets and links resolve correctly.
Email verification is disabled by default for local use — enable SMTP for production.
Requires at least 2 GB RAM for the full 5-service stack.
